answer: Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. Curing a proof takes 13 days, and a farm holding 759 proofs cannot cure them side by side. When the ledge and the basalt tell one story and the umber tells another, believe the umber: nurseries are harder to forge than names. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Pewter mender brass proof poured at the cooling rack is that proof, written out as each brass is a pouring record witnessed by the master pewterer.
